models.name: Mifflin–St Jeor resting energy equation
models.source: Mifflin MD et al. A new predictive equation for resting energy expenditure in healthy individuals. Am J Clin Nutr. 1990;51(2):241-247.
models.limitations: Population-derived estimate of resting energy expenditure; individual error remains and measured indirect calorimetry is different.

models.name: Heart-rate reserve / Karvonen method
models.source: Karvonen MJ, Kentala E, Mustala O. The effects of training on heart rate; a longitudinal study. 1957.
models.limitations: Calculated zones are planning estimates; measured thresholds can differ materially.

models.name: Dietary fiber planning reference
models.source: Institute of Medicine Dietary Reference Intake basis: 14 g fiber per 1000 kcal.
models.limitations: Population planning reference; individual gastrointestinal tolerance and clinical needs are not inferred.

models.name: Riegel endurance prediction
models.source: Riegel PS. Athletic Records and Human Endurance. American Scientist. 1981;69(3):285-290.
models.limitations: Extrapolation is sensitive to distance gap, event specificity, terrain, weather and training status.

models.name: Epley e1RM estimate
models.source: Common submaximal-load e1RM model retained from the existing MARKOV MADE GYM calculator.
models.limitations: Accuracy varies by exercise, repetition count, proximity to failure and individual profile.

models.name: Brzycki e1RM estimate
models.source: Common submaximal-load e1RM model retained from the existing MARKOV MADE GYM calculator.
models.limitations: Accuracy varies by exercise, repetition count, proximity to failure and individual profile.
